summary: Phase 8E — Commission by Package & Monthly Payout tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest cases pass covering (a) master-packages endpoint returns {id,name,product_type,code,status} and enforces super_admin RBAC (sales+accounting 403), (b) calculate on a fresh period auto-populates payout_month=next_month & sa_approval=PENDING and moves to REVIEW, (c) commission priority Package > ProductType > Default correctly picks the pkg-A tiered scheme (12 pax @ Rp300k tier) while pkg-B falls back to UMROH default (Rp100k) and DEFAULT ALL scheme is overridden, (d) tiered PER_PAX: rate chosen from tier by TOTAL pax per scheme group (5+4+3=12 -> 10-19 tier), (e) eligibility: PARTIAL/DP booking excluded (0 items generated), (f) PATCH /closings/{p}/status status=PAID gated with 400 when: not-CLOSED, sa_approval!=APPROVED, and current_month<payout_month (2027-03 payout=2027-04 gated), (g) PATCH /closings/{p}/approval requires reason for REJECTED and REVISION (400) but not APPROVED, and rejects invalid decisions, (h) Super Admin can adjust a line even when closing is CLOSED, (i) GET /pending-approval super_admin only, (j) GET /accounting-summary groups CLOSED+APPROVED with future payout into upcoming_payout; sales gets 403 (no commission.manage), (k) scheme create RBAC blocks accounting (super_admin only), (l) sales /commissions/my returns bookings[] with commission_month/payout_month/tier/status per-booking. Frontend: Super Admin /commission shows payout-overview + Commission Master tab with searchable Package combobox (25 pkgs loaded, dropdown option testids present); Approvals /approvals shows tab-commission-approval + commission-approval-table for super admin only. Sales sees /commission MyCommission page with my-bookings-table. Accounting sees payout-overview + tab-schemes but no tab-commission-approval on /approvals (expected).

ui_bugs.issue: React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' when rendering tiers or scheme rows. Cosmetic but should be fixed by adding a stable key to the mapped children.

issues: Radix Warning: Missing Description/aria-describedby for DialogContent — a11y minor.

action_items: (low) Add unique `key` prop inside SchemesTab list rendering to silence React warning.
(low) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Commission Master dialog for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /commissions/master-packages sorts by 'name' but many package documents actually store the display name in 'package_name'; the mongo sort key is inconsistent (works because it falls through) — consider sorting by 'package_name' or using an aggregation with $ifNull to guarantee alphabetical ordering.

_commission_status returns 'APPROVED' when CLOSED+sa_approval=APPROVED AND payout_month>current_month, while the copy on sales page groups PENDING/PAID; verify that string is what the sales UI expects.
server.py is 4945 lines — long past the 700-line guideline; extract commission routes to /app/backend/routers/commission.py.
_compute_period recomputes packages one-by-one per booking (N+1). For large datasets, batch the packages by $in query.
